scope: Secondary precision diagnostic for the retrieval-competition policy. It changes no action, probability, reader or promotion criterion. The 91 complete calibration questions already showed a reduction of held-dialogue, question-weighted mean window variance for credit-minus-native in 11 of 12 windows; this motivated reporting the same correction on future randomized observations.
estimator: For each target dialogue compute a mean F1 for each question type across all four paths on donor questions in the other five sessions-5-8 training dialogues. Use the donor-wide mean when the type is absent. Estimate each arm's return by physical two-path HT minus this frozen constant times (twice the observed mass of the two paths minus one). Keep ordinary HT and paired focal F1 unchanged and visible. Capture all later windows with any observed score before numerical registration, report subsequent windows separately, preserve per-dialogue and per-type sample sizes. The calibration design variance enumerates the four equi-probable pivot/background assignments within each held window; it does not estimate a joint across-window standard error.
